name: sketchroom-monorepo
description: Realtime multiplayer drawing and guessing game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "shared,server,client" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
